issuerName: Vesta Real Estate Corporation, S.A.B. de C.V.

segments.name: Industrial real estate
segments.description: Owns, manages, develops and leases industrial parks and industrial buildings for light-manufacturing and logistics clients in Mexico.
segments.evidence: Vesta manages its operations on an aggregated, single segment basis for purposes of assessing performance and making operating decisions and, accordingly, has only one reporting and operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rental income under operating leases, plus energy income and reimbursable building services recovering certain property operating expenses.
revenueModel.evidence: Rental income from operating leases is recognized on a straight-line basis over the term of the relevant lease.
